subtopics.label: Opioid Prescribing Practices and Policy Interventions
subtopics.description: Research examining opioid prescribing patterns, state prescribing cap laws, prescription drug monitoring programs, and policy interventions aimed at reducing opioid overprescribing in surgical and chronic pain contexts. Includes studies on postoperative opioid use, persistent opioid use, and the effects of regulatory changes on dispensing behavior.

subtopics.label: Medications for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD) and Treatment Access
subtopics.description: Studies on medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder including buprenorphine, methadone, and extended-release naltrexone, covering treatment initiation, retention, cost-effectiveness, and barriers to access in primary care, emergency department, and justice settings. Includes policy analyses of MOUD coverage and payment models.

subtopics.label: Naloxone Distribution, Harm Reduction Programs, and Overdose Prevention
subtopics.description: Research on naloxone distribution programs, syringe service programs, overdose prevention centers, and harm reduction messaging strategies. Covers racial/ethnic disparities in naloxone access, the role of pharmacies and community programs, and the impact of harm reduction services on overdose mortality.

subtopics.label: Cannabis Use, Legalization Policy, and Health Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining the effects of medical and recreational cannabis legalization on opioid use, chronic pain treatment, cannabis use disorder, and public health outcomes. Includes research on adolescent cannabis use, cannabis product labeling, and the neurobiological effects of cannabinoids.

subtopics.label: Neurobiology and Preclinical Models of Alcohol Use Disorder
subtopics.description: Preclinical and neurobiological research on alcohol use disorder including animal models of binge drinking, sex differences in alcohol consumption, brain circuit mechanisms, and neuroimaging studies of heavy alcohol use. Covers BNST function, hippocampal changes, and estrogen signaling in alcohol behavior.

subtopics.label: Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease: Clinical Outcomes and Treatment
subtopics.description: Clinical research on alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD) including prognostic factors, liver transplantation access and outcomes, relapse predictors, alcohol treatment discussions, and the role of alcohol taxes. Covers disparities in transplant access and the impact of alcohol use disorder treatment on liver disease outcomes.

subtopics.label: Molecular Mechanisms of Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease and Retinoid Metabolism
subtopics.description: Basic science research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying alcohol-associated liver disease, with emphasis on retinoid metabolism, retinoic acid receptor signaling, intestinal barrier function, and hepatic stress responses. Includes studies on fenretinide, RAR-beta, and ethanol-induced hepatic retinoid disruption.

subtopics.label: Hepatitis C Treatment and Prevention Among People Who Inject Drugs
subtopics.description: Research on hepatitis C virus (HCV) testing, treatment initiation, and care delivery models for people who inject drugs (PWID), including syringe service program-based care, rapid treatment initiation, cost-effectiveness analyses, and barriers to low-threshold HCV treatment. Covers Medicaid policy, co-located services, and HCV epidemiology in PWID populations.

subtopics.label: Prenatal Substance Use, Child Welfare Policy, and Neonatal Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on prenatal substance use policies including punitive versus supportive legal frameworks, their effects on neonatal outcomes, infant maltreatment reports, child welfare involvement, and treatment-seeking behavior among pregnant people. Covers neonatal abstinence syndrome, toxicology screening, and state-level legal mapping.

subtopics.label: Economic Burden and Cost-Effectiveness of Opioid Use Disorder Interventions
subtopics.description: Economic analyses of opioid use disorder including cost-of-illness estimates, cost-effectiveness of pharmacological and digital therapeutics, budget impact tools for MOUD in justice settings, and economic losses from overdose deaths. Covers health-related quality of life outcomes and economic evaluations in clinical trial networks.

subtopics.label: Stigma, Provider Attitudes, and Barriers to Substance Use Disorder Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies on stigma experienced by people with substance use disorders in healthcare settings, provider attitudes toward OUD treatment, and structural barriers to care. Includes development of stigma measurement scales, qualitative studies of patient and provider perspectives, and interventions to reduce stigma in clinical and public contexts.

subtopics.label: Tobacco Use, Smoking Cessation, and E-Cigarette Research
subtopics.description: Research on smoking cessation interventions, tobacco use epidemiology, e-cigarette and vaping trends, and pharmacist or provider-delivered cessation programs. Covers smoking cessation after stroke, nicotine metabolism, adolescent vaping, and mental health comorbidities associated with electronic cigarette use.

subtopics.label: Neurobiological Mechanisms of Opioid Reward, Stress, and Sex Differences
subtopics.description: Preclinical research on the neurobiological underpinnings of opioid use including hippocampal opioid receptor distribution, sex differences in opioid system responses, chronic stress effects on opioid gene expression, and endocannabinoid modulation of opioid reward. Covers delta opioid receptors, glutamate receptors, and oxycodone conditioned place preference models.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Impact on Substance Use Services and Overdose
subtopics.description: Research examining how the COVID-19 pandemic affected substance use disorder treatment, harm reduction services, healthcare utilization among people who use drugs, and overdose rates. Covers telehealth expansion, service disruptions at syringe programs, policy adaptations, and the pandemic's effect on drug overdose economic burden.

subtopics.label: Adolescent and Young Adult Substance Use: Risk Factors and Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies on substance use initiation, risk factors, and interventions among adolescents and young adults, including alcohol use and neurodevelopment, prescription stimulant misuse, trauma-related substance use, and training programs for treating co-occurring mental health and substance use disorders in youth.

subtopics.label: Opioid Prescribing and Pain Management in Cancer Patients
subtopics.description: Research examining opioid prescription trends, access, and outcomes specifically in cancer patients, including bone metastasis, pancreatic cancer, and Medicare coverage restrictions for cancer pain management.

subtopics.label: Multimodal and Non-Opioid Analgesia Strategies in Perioperative Care
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating non-opioid and multimodal analgesic approaches to reduce opioid consumption in surgical and perioperative settings, including ketamine, complementary medicine, and nonopioid analgesic prescriptions.

subtopics.label: Prescription Drug Monitoring, Patient Behavior, and Long-Term Opioid Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on prescription drug monitoring programs, patient behaviors during long-term opioid therapy, public perceptions of opioid use, and EHR-based interventions to guide opioid prescribing.

subtopics.label: Safer Opioid Supply Programs and Drug Decriminalization Policies
subtopics.description: Evaluation of safer opioid supply policies and drug decriminalization initiatives, particularly in British Columbia, examining their effects on opioid prescribing rates, hospitalizations, and overdose outcomes.

subtopics.label: Racial and Socioeconomic Disparities in Opioid and Pain Treatment Access
subtopics.description: Studies examining how race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic factors shape access to opioid analgesics and pain treatments, including community-level disparities in opioid distribution and racial differences in medication use.

subtopics.label: Suicide, Mental Health Comorbidities, and Behavioral Addictions
subtopics.description: Research on suicide rates, decedent profiles, and mental health comorbidities including gambling disorder and psychiatric diagnoses, with a focus on identifying risk factors and prevention strategies.

subtopics.label: Integration of Behavioral Health and Addiction Treatment into Medical Care and Policy
subtopics.description: Studies addressing policy frameworks and implementation strategies for integrating mental health and addiction treatment into general medical care, including mental health parity enforcement and hospice behavioral health needs.

subtopics.label: HIV Prevention, PrEP Access, and Health Services for People Who Use Drugs
subtopics.description: Research on HIV prevention strategies including PrEP navigation and contingency management for transgender women, sexual minority men, and people who inject drugs with substance use disorders.

subtopics.label: Sedative and Benzodiazepine Prescribing Risks in Vulnerable Populations
subtopics.description: Studies examining the risks associated with sedative and benzodiazepine prescribing in older adults and ICU survivors, including fall risk after stroke and new sedative prescriptions following critical illness.

subtopics.label: Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders and Alcohol-Related Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Research on the physical and health consequences of prenatal alcohol exposure including fetal alcohol spectrum disorder ocular measurements, and alcohol's association with breast tissue composition and other comorbidities.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging and Machine Learning Methods in Substance Use and Psychiatric Research
subtopics.description: Studies applying machine learning and deep learning methods to neuroimaging data for interpreting psychiatric and substance use disorder-related brain changes, including interpretability tools and sub-cohort analysis.

subtopics.label: Medicaid Coverage Policies and Access to HCV and Specialty Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on Medicaid policy changes affecting access to hepatitis C treatment and other specialty care, including the removal of fee-for-service restrictions and their impact on provider experience with managed care organizations.
